needs.premise: One live native invocation and root-cell view, bounded one effect/writer/borrow/nested debt, root relocation and two epochs; safe-point completeness, construction maps, native frame survival, coherent atomics and complete adapter census are premises; nonexhaustive finite simulation, not C source or liveness proof

27 conditional declarations: Eligible boundary exclusions, exclusive mutator/collector root-cell authority, relocation/cache refresh, same-invocation resume and View Step/Trace preservation; separate Ready and Boundary premises; no complete QNT/C/ABI simulation or native weak-memory proof

ParticipatingParkReceipt requires a generated SafePointSpec with return PointId, FrameSpec and initialized-field map after all relevant writes, complete continuation frame and register/saved/native root materialization; ___W_ALL is module/procedure-specific GVM state transfer, not arbitrary C stack scanning; rest/keyword construction calls W_ALL before complete frames are built, so that location cannot issue a receipt; retain Scheme completion plan or reject until scan-safe

Freeze root topology, writer admission and backing lifetime, not immutable SCMOBJ values; collector owns updateable canonical root cells while owner is parked; include continuation/frame map, registers, saved/type-cache/processor roots, all RC domains, generated native handles, marker and construction roots; publish after last writer and permit release, scan only after canonical VM acceptance; nonzero RC scan and raw cached SCMOBJ aliases remain open source obligations

Retain the existing native invocation stack/catcher/code/result/input envelope, but reconcile every GC-relevant effect, raw root borrower, helper and nested activation before park; closing entry cannot revoke issued stores; native-only external operation may remain active only under separately proved no-managed-access and no-GC-critical-wait profile, not by renaming its count zero; unqualified or unknown relevant operation retains source debt and blocks receipt

Source retains root/native/pool custody through Prepare and Offer; canonical VM accept under scan/resume exclusion transfers control responsibility and signs identity-bound ParticipatingParkReceipt for same live activation, park attempt, epoch, SafePointSpec, root view, borrow census and native-frame lease; release/acquire publication precedes scanning; lost acceptance ACK is resolved by protected canonical query, never permit restoration, task replay or disposal

Resume same native invocation only after scan claim/release, whole strong/weak/cleanup/capacity result, context preparation, exact same live native owner/VM incarnation binding and relocated-root reload; scan claim and resume claim share atomic state arbitration; acquire fresh next-epoch write permit before resumed managed access, retire old scan capability and root view only after readers drain; notification, receipt ACK or GC request alone does not authorize reentry

Preserve synchronous Tcl char-string result and borrowed argv while Scheme body reaches a real safe point, not callback replay or invented pending return; nested callbacks need complete activation-stack census and LIFO native/catcher roots; exception/continuation escape is a separate same-owner exit path whose guard settles park/result/marker debt before native stack destruction; helper longjmp, arbitrary thread death and uninstrumented foreign stack movement cannot qualify same-call resume

Owner closes new admission under shared registry exclusion; last relevant effect/borrow completion and generated materialization precede release-published root-view offer, canonical park acceptance and acquire scan claim; collector root updates precede release scan completion and owner acquire reload; whole-round context/binding precede fresh epoch permit and resume claim; scan claim, cancellation/exit and resume arbitrate on one canonical state, no mutex held while awaiting owner/GC callback; actual C layout, lock order, weak-memory and raw adapter coverage remain open

No existing future-epoch execution-gate issuer; introduce VM-owned AdmissionDomain keyed by VM/domain/epoch/incarnation, with early native ingress covering every callback origin before data_rc, marker allocation, PSTATE reads or closure-self mutation; stop current publication admission, reconcile publication postludes and all claim reservations, then sign FutureEpochGate for retained unstarted async tasks only after canonical VM root/resource/code custody and manifest/exclusion evidence

Owned procedural interrupt queue needs one ordered dequeue-to-claim and close-to-detach cut under compatible exclusion; register claim before removing head/unlocking, count publisher from header initialization through queue insertion and post-unlock raise_interrupt_pstate; queued task may move to VM future queue with exact execution/release operation semantics, borrowed argument snapshot and custody; preserve accepted enqueue order and per-origin result causality, including canceled claim position unless reordering separately admitted; empty old queue or interrupt masking is not zero in-flight work

Future task and parked current invocation retain GC-visible roots, immutable input snapshots or qualified borrowed storage, native payload/code/catcher leases and exact result identity; VM transfer is not disposal, nonzero processor roots require all-domain scanner integration, native deletion/refcount decrement cannot reclaim before old invocation borrowers drain; unknown native or claim outcome retains custody and cannot authorize replay/refund

Defer only an origin whose request/result contract permits retained asynchronous task and whose pre-entry transport has no unknown issued invocation; direct synchronous Tcl scheme_call_cmd needs immediate char-string result and borrowed argv, so deferring inside it or returning invented success/pending is not equivalent; gate upstream initiation, qualify participating wait on original invocation, or refuse future-task admission; no synchronous GC wait for a callback whose entry waits for that same GC

After full strong/weak/cleanup/capacity result and selected context preparation, bind exact live owner/VM context, reload relocated root handles, then publish next epoch authority; GC interrupt notification alone precedes prepare_mem_pstate and is not WholeRoundResumeSeal; claimFuture atomically joins next epoch before marker allocation and Scheme entry, parked resume obtains fresh write authority for same native activation; stale old epoch/context/root/owner rejects without guessed rebind

Close/claim/cancel/native-issue publish under one canonical atomic/exclusion protocol; release certificate follows last current writer and publisher postlude, acquire certifier sees roots and parked views; next epoch release follows capacity/context/binding/root reload and acquire claimant joins matching epoch; all raw callbacks use compatible lifetime-protected ingress before first managed effect; counter generation alone cannot revoke issued stores or cached function pointers, actual C atomic layout and native ABI remain open

parkCosts.bound: One admitted current invocation -> one park accept + one resume; extra native invocations=0
parkCosts.addedCost: SafePointSpec, root view, canonical park/scan/resume state
parkCosts.condition: Current Gambit already collects inside callbacks; this preserves that ability during worker separation, not a new measured speedup

parkCosts.removedWork: Replace blanket W_ALL assumption with generated completion cut
parkCosts.bound: One complete spill/root/constructor map per park; no park at known incomplete rest frame
parkCosts.addedCost: Scheme completion plans, verifier and descriptor/code lifetime
parkCosts.condition: Actual generated spill and constructor coverage must close before old macro logic can retire

parkCosts.removedWork: Use described canonical cells instead of duplicating every root value
parkCosts.bound: Metadata O(A+R+D); root visit O(R); no mandatory O(reachable heap) snapshot
parkCosts.addedCost: A activations, R distinct root slots, D active native/effect obligations
parkCosts.condition: Alias census must be complete; caller-held copies require handles/reload, not an invented immutable value snapshot

parkCosts.removedWork: Drain only relevant issued effects, not require original native call return
parkCosts.bound: Native invocation stays live; GC-relevant effects/borrowers/nested writers must be0
parkCosts.addedCost: Effect/origin registry, completion evidence and lock dependency profile
parkCosts.condition: Native-only outstanding work requires separate isolation proof; unknown relevant work cannot become zero on timeout

parkCosts.removedWork: Avoid retrying native operation after lost park acceptance ACK
parkCosts.bound: One canonical accept per park identity; query adds0 invocations
parkCosts.addedCost: Protected attempt/result lookup and retained source pins until resolution
parkCosts.condition: Failed preaccept retains source; accepted unknown response remains VM duty; no receipt reuse across attempts

parkCosts.removedWork: Permit root rewriting while mutator is parked
parkCosts.bound: At most one modeled scan claim; no simultaneous mutator permit
parkCosts.addedCost: Release/acquire view, exclusive scan/resume state and reader drainage
parkCosts.condition: Full C order proof and independent-worker integration still open; no relaxed load shortcut

parkCosts.bound: One context prepare/bind/reload sequence per resumed park; starts stays1
parkCosts.addedCost: Whole-round result, root generation and exact owner incarnation
parkCosts.condition: Same native stack must remain alive; moving raw C catcher to different worker is refused

parkCosts.removedWork: Retain full activation chain instead of treating inner return as outer quiescence
parkCosts.bound: O(A) live activation/exit records; all relevant nested debts settle before park
parkCosts.addedCost: LIFO marker/catcher roots and exit-vs-scan arbitration
parkCosts.condition: Continuation escape uses generated exit guard; arbitrary native longjmp/unregistered roots reject profile

parkCosts.removedWork: GC waits for park handoff rather than synchronous result completion
parkCosts.bound: Removes edge GC -> callback-finish when qualified park exists
parkCosts.addedCost: No GC-critical lock held by parked owner; cleanup/root dependencies explicit
parkCosts.condition: No universal latency or liveness bound; cleanup requiring owner entry must be delayed or rejected

parkCosts.removedWork: No task payload duplication merely to park same call
parkCosts.bound: Peak=max_t(H+P+N+Q); delta inherited marker 24*M(t) plus park/view/log pools and longer retention
parkCosts.addedCost: Native stack, roots, code, borrowed inputs and unresolved resources stay charged
parkCosts.condition: No measured/proved peak decrease; unknown debt can retain backing indefinitely

parkCosts.removedWork: Replace direct managed entry / blanket park flag / unqualified PSTATE lifetime
parkCosts.bound: 0 production paths retired; admitted cohort only after source/order/ABI obligations
parkCosts.addedCost: Scheme-generated safe-point/exit plans and typed modern C RootRegistry/AdmissionDomain
parkCosts.condition: Keep C portable backend; low-level W/R instructions may be generated internally, not falsely claimed eliminated

parkCosts.removedWork: Share semantic plans and typed lifetime protocol without second runtime language
parkCosts.bound: 0 Zig-only runtime work elimination shown for park/root/native safety
parkCosts.addedCost: Both need same safepoint, borrow/scan, native stack, atomic and exception proofs
parkCosts.condition: Choose modern C mainline; CPU benefit needs actual removed baseline work > added protocol work; wait-cycle removal is a separate graph property, current cooperative GC already resumes in-call

nodes.labelText: Same live native invocation\nTcl -> SFUN -> Scheme
Close new entry / nested admission\nexisting effects remain owed
Safe point + complete init\ndrain relevant writes / borrows
Materialize RA / frames / roots\nrevoke old mutator permit
Offer updateable root view\nsource keeps backing pins
Acquire scan claim\ncollector may update root cells
Prepare context + same owner bind\nreload relocated roots
Fresh next-epoch resume claim\nsame native stack; starts stays1
Unknown relevant write / dead frame\nretain debt; refuse unsafe receipt
SysML -> ASCENT -> QNT / Lean\nsource and C-order gaps open

atomic accept; ACK may be lost
VM control; native owner still live

callers.actualChain: scheme_call_cmd -> tcltk_call(data_rc,argv+1) -> Scheme apply -> result C string installed in Tcl
callers.hazard: Deferral/replay loses synchronous result, borrowed native args and original return stack
callers.replacement: Retain same native activation/input/result/code leases; park only at admitted Scheme/generated boundary

callers.actualChain: SFUN fetches PSTATE, allocates marker, converts and calls ___call; conversion errors can call Scheme handler
callers.hazard: An entry gate in ___call is after marker allocation and raw root effects
callers.replacement: Scheme generator emits origin/safe-point/exit plan; modern C ingress owns full conversion activation and root census

callers.actualChain: W_ALL selects generated M/P macros; supplied kernel output writes selected heap/fp/registers; R macros reload
callers.hazard: Materializes specific GVM locals, not all arbitrary C roots or complete object initialization
callers.replacement: SafePointSpec records actual required fields and maps; prove generated spill coverage and post-GC reload

callers.actualChain: Stack/heap checks save RA and GVM regs, W_ALL, run limit/GC, R_ALL and restore RA
callers.hazard: Reaching POLL/limit request is not itself completion of spill/root/initialization duties
callers.replacement: Receipt cut after completion plan, not check predicate; use FrameSpec and exact resume PointId

callers.actualChain: sync interrupt saves RA/W_ALL -> service_sync_op -> barrier/combined operation loop; result delivered before R_ALL
callers.hazard: Current processor is both execution context and collector participant; interrupt request alone cannot authorize independent worker
callers.replacement: Split context freeze, participant acknowledgment and worker scan authority; preserve merged operation result/round identity

callers.actualChain: Rest/keyword CONS loop W_ALL -> heap_limit -> R_ALL, then explicitly builds complete frames before GC
callers.hazard: W_ALL before frame repair is a real inadmissible receipt location
callers.replacement: Carry constructor progress/root plan through complete-frame cut or scan-safe shell; do not park at every W_ALL

callers.actualChain: Still allocation links storage before caller field init; make marker allocates before copying input procedure with root TODO
callers.hazard: Unknown initialization or unrooted moving input cannot be cured by park flag
callers.replacement: Generated InitSpec with scan-safe fields and root-before-allocation; retain construction escrow until complete

callers.actualChain: mark_continuation reads ps.fp, return-specific frame size/link/gcmap and captured continuation
callers.hazard: Native C stack is not this scanner; stale frame map/cursor or changed stack break loses roots
callers.replacement: Frozen FrameSpec-backed topology and live native frame; collector updates described stack/heap root cells

callers.actualChain: mark_registers/saved/type_cache/processor scan actual PSTATE arrays after continuation
callers.hazard: Freeze snapshot of SCMOBJ values becomes stale after relocation; descriptions and backing must survive
callers.replacement: Exclusive updateable cells plus post-scan R_ALL/handle reload; participant-independent root adapter

callers.actualChain: RC data cells in per-PSTATE list are passed by address to mark_array; mark_rc selected in P0 branch
callers.hazard: Nonzero RC coverage and raw data_rc setters/borrowers not solved by current P0 scan
callers.replacement: All-domain RootRegistry enumerates stable RC backing and controlled access; freeze link topology and release old readers

callers.actualChain: Publisher spans queue unlock to PSTATE wakeup; service removes task before native execute_fn
callers.hazard: Empty queue/closed entry misses claimed callback, late postlude and nested cleanup work
callers.replacement: Import early ingress, publisher lease and dequeue-to-claim protocol; nested activation debt stays counted

callers.actualChain: condvar select wrapper W_ALL before os select, R_ALL after return; select-abort writes wakeup pipe
callers.hazard: Blocking syscall and wakeup do not establish root-view acceptance or arbitrary syscall interruption
callers.replacement: Qualify native wait lock/effect/borrow profile; return to participating boundary or explicit no-managed-access native wait

callers.actualChain: ___call saves marker/frame and installs stack catcher; return checks processor and live marker then unwinds
callers.hazard: Moving to helper thread, repeated entry or destroying stack invalidates native return rights
callers.replacement: Preserve same native thread/catcher lease, original call count and exception guard; no collector longjmp

callers.actualChain: SFUN kill/propagate path, ___run catcher and Tcl delete release resources across native boundaries
callers.hazard: Parked activation is not completed; deletion or inner return cannot retire outer root/catcher backing
callers.replacement: Activation stack census, exit-vs-scan arbitration, deferred resource disposition and outer native-frame retention

callers.actualChain: GC barriers, cleanup/resize/fudge then notify GC before prepare fp/hp/limits; binding function sets TLS/affinity
callers.hazard: Notification or TLS pointer is not fresh context/root authorization
callers.replacement: Whole-round/context/binding/root reload then atomic fresh permit; scanned root alone not complete round

callers.actualChain: PSTATE cleanup frees RC/still/OS state; thread join comes later and errors do not preserve canonical envelope
callers.hazard: Death/failed join cannot prove arbitrary in-flight store stopped or native stack recoverable
callers.replacement: Retain VM root/resource debt; known stop may allow cleanup but never resurrect dead native invocation; unknown refuses receipt/resume
